evidence: backend/servers/reality-server/src/routes/articles.rs:158 — list_articles builds the article full-text filter as let search_pattern = query.search.as_ref().map(|s| format!("%{}%", s)); and binds it (L190 / L206 .bind(&search_pattern)) into two ILIKE $2 predicates: `(a.title ILIKE $2 OR a.excerpt ILIKE $2)` on the list query and the matching COUNT(*) query. The user-controlled `query.search` string is wrapped in %...% but is NOT escaped for SQL LIKE metacharacters (`%`, `_`, and the `\` escape char), and no `ESCAPE` clause is attached to the ILIKE.

Impact (correctness, not injection): because the pattern is a bound parameter there is no SQL-injection exposure, but every `%` or `_` a user types is interpreted as an ILIKE wildcard rather than a literal. Searching `100%` collapses to `%100%%` which matches any title containing `100` followed by anything (the trailing `%` is inert, but a mid-string `%` like `a%b` becomes 'a' <anything> 'b'); searching a bare `_` matches every article whose title/excerpt is non-empty; searching `_` or `%`-heavy strings turns a precise search into a near-match-all, and the inconsistency also skews the COUNT(*) total used for pagination. This is a user-facing search-correctness bug on the public reality-portal articles/blog endpoint (no auth required), low severity.

Landable backend-only fix: escape the three LIKE metacharacters in the user term before wrapping and declare the escape char, e.g. let escaped = s.replace('\\', "\\\\").replace('%', "\\%").replace('_', "\\_"); let search_pattern = format!("%{}%", escaped); and change both predicates to `... ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '\\'`. Apply to both the list query (routes/articles.rs ~L188) and the COUNT(*) query (~L204) so the result set and the pagination total stay consistent. A shared helper (e.g. in util/) would also cover any sibling LIKE-search path added later. Confidence medium: static review only — the unescaped-wildcard flow is code-verified end-to-end (format! at L158 -> bind at L190/L206 -> ILIKE without ESCAPE), but no runtime query was executed.
